visual_inventory.supplement: AMISOS-R supplementary appendix is referenced by the article but was not present in the Drive packet; explicitly disclosed as unavailable.

semantic_spot_checks.source: Results/Table 2: completers n=7, AMISOS-R 30.43 to 24.29; mean change -6.14, p=.023. Conclusion calls results preliminary.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: SEA preserves n=7 completer result, -6.14-point change, and preliminary interpretation.

semantic_spot_checks.source: Table 3: treated-population LOCF n=8, AMISOS-R 30.50 to 25.13; mean change -5.37, p=.026.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: SEA reports the same values and distinguishes this analysis from the completer analysis.

semantic_spot_checks.source: No control group; small sample; no follow-up; two subpopulations; one therapist; evaluator not blinded; no fidelity measures.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: All consequential limitations are represented in the section condensation and appraisal.

semantic_spot_checks.source: Figure 2 has seven completers; Table 4 shows two full responders (#3 and #9), one additional CGI-I=3 patient (#7), and patient-level trajectories.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: SEA figure/table sections preserve seven completers and patient-level values; full response is reported as 2/8 (25%).

semantic_spot_checks.source: Abstract says n=8 for -6.14 while Table 2/results say n=7; prose says SCL-90 fell 33% though Table 2 implies ~10.4%; “no adverse events” coexists with suicidal ideation/side effects.
semantic_spot_checks.sea: SEA explicitly flags all three reporting inconsistencies without silently resolving them.

source_integrity_findings.issue: participant terminology changes from included=10 to treated=8

overall.note: Existing SEA is identity-matched, source-faithful, parseable, visually reconciled, and sufficiently explicit about internal source inconsistencies. No SEA regeneration was required.
